title: Mixed Event — Connect Hearts Message — Episode6 How We're Still Together

meta.Event Outline: The second-years at Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy are assigned a work shadowing program. Interested in learning about making fun memories for visitors, Saki, Emu and Shiho choose to visit an event planning company.

rows.Line: Event Venue

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So you were out shopping, and got into a fight...

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line: Yes, we got completely fed up with each other and split up. Before I knew it, I was here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's terrible...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (They came here to have fun, but they're both all alone now after their argument. That's so sad...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Umm... We should probably apologize for asking you so many personal questions.

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line: No, I actually feel a lot better now after telling you two...!

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line: Also, thinking back on what happened, our argument really began over something tiny. We basically fought over nothing...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Nothing?

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line: So, when we met up earlier, she told me that she forgot to have breakfast.

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line: Then, I responded, “You stayed up all night again, didn't you? You gotta get plenty of sleep and eat right.” And then she got mad at me...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't see anything wrong with what you said...

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line: But I do go a little too far sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line: Yes, I am bothered by these sorts of little things, but she's also a bit of a mess, you know?

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line: I'll point that out, and we end up in an argument like we did earlier.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I see...
You have the exact opposite personalities.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Don't they remind you of us when we were kids?

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You see, we're also childhood friends.
And we argued all the time when we were little.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, we are pretty similar...

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line: Excuse me, but how did you two make up each time?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... How did we make up?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami or Ichika usually stepped in to stop us every time we began arguing...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's right! They did all sorts of stuff to help us make up!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. They had us have snacks together, or play at the park...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Neither of us would budge in the beginning, but we usually realized how silly we were being.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Before we knew it, we'd completely forget about whatever argument we were having.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also... Whenever we'd fight, you'd suddenly apologize out of nowhere, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's because it always hurt really bad when we were fighting. And not getting to play with you always made me so sad...

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line: We might not be any different.

rows.Speaker: Saki & Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line: My friend is usually the one who takes the first step in patching things up...

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line: She'll share fun videos with me or invite me out somewhere. We'll talk and laugh, and go back to being friends like nothing had happened.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I've never really thought about us like this before, but it really isn't common for people with completely different personalities to stay friends for years and years.

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line:
That's a good point...
A part of me just figured that we'd never be rid of each other.

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line: But maybe the real reason we've stuck together all this time is because she makes a real effort to stay with me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (She makes a real effort...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(We split apart for a time...
But we were able to get our band back together and become friends again.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Those things alone made me unbelievably happy...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But we're able to stay together like this now because they're all doing their best to make sure we don't get scattered to the wind again.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (In other words...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's hard to realize this kind of thing while just living day to day...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it really makes you want to say, “Thank you!” to the people who try so hard to stay by your side, huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line:
I agree...
It's pretty amazing, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line: I... I want to tell her.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. In that case, we recommend writing her a card!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, we can help you further if you like.

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
Then, if it's alright, I think I'd like to make my friend a message card.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes, of course!
Shopping Mall Premises

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe☆ I'm so glad we managed to find the perfect puppet for you, MEIKO. It's so cute♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe. I'm looking forward to giving it a voice!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<So, Emu!
Let's get this show on the road.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“White Day is just around the corner!
I really wanna tell my friend just how much I appreciate them!”

rows.Speaker: Puppet
rows.Line:
<I have just the thing for you, Emu!
Here, take this♪>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Wow, this card's so beautiful!”

rows.Speaker: Puppet
rows.Line: <Why don't you take this card, decorate it and write a nice message for your friend?>

rows.Speaker: Puppet
rows.Line: <It'll be a true one-of-a-kind!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“I wanna try doing that!
Can you show me how to decorate it, Ms. Puppet?”

rows.Speaker: Puppet
rows.Line: <Of course! Let's work on it together!>

rows.Speaker: Shopper
rows.Line: What's going on over there? A puppet show?

rows.Speaker: Shopper
rows.Line: Hey, what's she making?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“I just gotta put these stickers on, and...
It's finished☆”

rows.Speaker: Puppet
rows.Line:
<Nice work, Emu!
What a lovely card!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Thanks! So, Ms. Puppet, this is for you!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Thank you for always playing with me!”

rows.Speaker: Puppet
rows.Line: <Oh...! Hehe. Thank you as well!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Hehe♪ I hope we keep being friends forever and ever!”

rows.Speaker: Shopper
rows.Line:
Writing message cards sounds fun.
Wanna go take a look?

rows.Speaker: Shopper
rows.Line: Yeah. Let's go check out the event area in the courtyard.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, MEIKO, our plan's working!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <We did it, Emu!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Huh...?
That girl just keeps staring at the sign for the event...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Does this mean she wants to make a message card for someone?)
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hello!
Are you interested in writing some message cards?

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler B
rows.Line:
Oh, no. I'm okay.
I was just thinking that my friend would really enjoy this event.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I see! You came here with your friend today?

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler B
rows.Line: Yeah. We came to grab some donuts here, since we heard that they're pretty good.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, they smell really yummy!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait... Where is your friend?

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler B
rows.Line:
Oh...
We actually got into an argument a bit ago.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! You got into an argument...?

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler B
rows.Line: At this point, it's sort of a regular occurrence.

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler B
rows.Line:
I mean, she's just so nit-picky.
“You need to eat a proper breakfast”, or “your skirt's too short, fix it”, that kind of thing...

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler B
rows.Line: So I said, “What are you, my mom?” After that, things got really out of hand.

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler B
rows.Line: And we both ended up storming off.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It sounds like she cares about you a lot!

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler B
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I also have a friend in class who's always telling me not to run in the corridor because it's dangerous, and how I'm going to catch a cold if I don't dress warmer...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I feel bad and apologize every time, but I also feel a little happy.

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler B
rows.Line: Happy?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Because her saying that means she doesn't want me to trip and get hurt, or feel gross after picking up a nasty cold.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Which is why my heart feels really warm every time!

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler B
rows.Line:
...
I see. You're such a nice person.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler B
rows.Line:
And you're right.
When she said what she did, I got really irritated...

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler B
rows.Line: But she wouldn't scold me like that if she didn't care about me.

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler B
rows.Line:
In hindsight...
I feel like I should show her at least some appreciation.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Then, what if you did that now?
By writing her a message card!

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler B
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You could give it to her with the donuts...
I bet you two will be smiling like peas in a pod afterwards!

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler B
rows.Line:
I'm not sure I can make her a good card...
Could you help me with that?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes! I'll give you all the help you need!

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler B
rows.Line:
Haha. Okay.
Then, I'll give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler B
rows.Line: Oh, I should see if she'll agree to meet up again later. Let's see... <Can we talk again today one more time?>

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler B
rows.Line: Oh, she replied... Wait, what?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh...?
